title: A Bakery for the Kitchen
author: Dominic Amberdale
blurb: Coral Whitlock, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
